::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/organization/model_prices/drift"}
#docs
USD events only. Models with no reported cost are not listed.

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `business` | `string` | no | Only this business's usage (biz_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `window` | `object` | The model price drift's window. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `model_price_drift`. One of `model_price_drift`. |
| `data.provider` | `string` | The payment provider. |
| `data.model` | `string` | The pricing model. |
| `data.reported_cost_minor` | `integer` | USD cents the calls reported. |
| `data.list_cost_minor` | `integer` | USD cents the list gives for the same tokens. |
| `data.difference_percent` | `number` | (reported ÷ list − 1) × 100. Positive: your calls cost more. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The drift per model. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/organization/model_prices/drift" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

    }
